crime: Every evening, one prisoner read with a cup of tea under the unwilting cherry tree in the library, and every evening she dozed off. {WITCH_NAME} sat beside her. Whenever the cup slipped from the girl's hand, {WITCH_NAME} had already watched its translucent double fall, and she caught the real cup in midair.

One evening during free time, the girl stopped her at the library door. "Don't come in tonight. Let me doze off and drop it for once." {WITCH_NAME} saw the girl's double shut the door on her; seconds later, the real door closed.
Once, at supper, she had seen her father's double get up and walk out the door while he still sat there laughing with her. He followed it out and never came back.

Late in free time that evening, she crossed the second-floor hall to the library door unseen, stepping only when each prisoner's double looked away, and later returned the same way. In the library, she drove the girl's temple against the corner of the table until the girl lay still. The cup fell. She caught it before it hit the floor and set it down beside the body, upright and full.

The prisoners testified that they had sat in sight of the library door all evening, from the moment the girl went in until lockup, and no one had gone in after her. In the trial court, the prisoners ruled that she had stumbled alone, half asleep, into the table corner.

Then one prisoner remembered what she had noticed in the library: the cup standing upright on the floor, full, without a drop spilled. They understood. {WITCH_NAME} had caught it, as she always did, and slipped through the gaps between their glances.
fields.epitaph: All she was ever asked to let fall was a cup.
execution: An iron doorframe rises from the execution stand, hung with a heavy iron door. She is chained upright against the latch post. First she watches the door's double swing shut on her. Then the iron door swings shut on her and keeps pressing, pinning her chest against the frame. The door stands shut. She hangs still between door and frame.

magic.name: Foreshadow
magic.text: She sees a ghostly double of everything that moves, a few seconds ahead of it.
